subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria - Medlytics trial (Week 1)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & success criteria - Medlytics trial

Thanks again for the call this morning - appreciate the practical breakdown of Medlytics' evaluation goals. Short recap + proposed next steps so we're aligned entering the trial: 

Summary of objectives
- Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and coded data extraction at scale
- Ensure latency and throughput meet production SLAs for triage workflows
- Confirm data handling meets Medlytics' security/compliance bar (SSO, audit logs, data retention)

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks)
- Week 0 (setup, 2-3 business days): grant test data access + set up dedicated trial namespace; confirm SSO and KMS integration requirements
- Week 1: run evaluation on 5k sample notes (provided by Medlytics) - measure precision/recall on extraction tasks and end-to-end latency at target QPS
- Week 2: scale test to 50k notes with batching, measure cost/throughput, and run final accuracy sweep; final demo and decision meeting on Fri, Nov 20

Success criteria (what you asked us to hit)
- Extraction F1 >= 0.88 for entities X/Y/Z (as measured on your labeled 5k set)
- 95th percentile latency < 450ms for single-note inference at 10 QPS
- Cost per 1k notes below $X (we'll provide estimates after initial run)
- Verified SSO + audit log availability for the trial namespace

Ownership & immediate action items
- Marissa (me): coordinate schedule, track success criteria, run weekly status calls
- Dylan (engineering): technical setup, access, and test harness (ETA for access: Nov 6)
- Ariel / Tom (Medlytics): provide the sample dataset (5k labeled) and a secure S3 link + list of compliance reviewers

Attachments:
- medlytics-poc-scope.pdf (scope & timeline)
- redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (technical checklist)

Please confirm the timeline and the Nov 20 decision/demo slot works for you. If that looks good I'll kick off the access requests and loop in our infra team.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
